intro: The vocabulary of history books, with the story of the bicycle, and how the past is told.
p.siglo.consejo: It is written in Roman numerals and read with cardinals: «siglo XIX» is «siglo diecinueve».
p.época.consejo: The accent marks the first syllable: «E-po-ka». «En aquella época» opens a description of the past.
p.inventor.consejo: Feminine: «inventora». It comes from «inventar». The v sounds like b.
p.invento.consejo: It is the noun of «inventar»: «el invento de la imprenta», «un invento útil».
p.rueda.consejo: The first r is strong: «RRWE-da». You say «rueda delantera» and «rueda trasera».
p.pedal.consejo: The stressed syllable is the last: «pe-DAL». There are also pedals on pianos and cars.
p.cadena.consejo: It is also a series of linked things: «cadena de montaje», «cadena de televisión».
p.manillar.consejo: The ll sounds like y: «ma-ni-YAR». It comes from «mano»: it is where you put your hands.
p.neumático.consejo: The accent marks «MA»: «neu-MA-ti-ko». In Mexico you also say «llanta».
p.fábrica.consejo: The accent marks «FA»: «FA-bri-ka». The verb is «fabricar».
p.fabricar.consejo: It is regular, but c changes to qu: «fabriqué». Cars, furniture and bicycles are manufactured.
p.carrera.consejo: The rr is strong. It is also a university degree: «hacer una carrera».
p.mejorar.consejo: It comes from «mejor». It works for things and people: «mejorar el diseño», «mejorar la salud».
p.extenderse.consejo: The e becomes ie: «se extiende». A fashion, a story or a fire spreads.
b1.texto:
**Time.** A **siglo** is a hundred years: the XIX century is read «siglo diecinueve». An **época** is a period with its own features: **en aquella época**.

**Inventions.** An **inventor** creates an **invento**. Then someone **fabrica** it in a **fábrica** and others **mejoran** it. A **moda** can **extenderse** across a whole country.

**The bicycle.** It has two **ruedas**, a **manillar**, **pedales**, a **cadena** and **neumáticos**. Soon there were **carreras**.

**The tenses of history.** The **indefinido** tells the events: **apareció**, **duró**. The **imperfecto** describes the background: **era**, **había**, **tenía**. And the **passive** is common: **fue fabricada**.
b2.f2.texto: The rider pushed the machine along with his feet.
b2.f3.texto: When did they put the pedals on?
b2.f4.texto: Around 1860 they added pedals to the front wheel.
b2.f5.texto: My grandfather made bicycles in a small factory.
b2.f6.texto: The modern bicycle was mass-produced around 1885.
b2.f7.texto: Air tyres made journeys more comfortable.
b4.texto:
**The preterite** tells the events, one after another: **apareció**, **duró**, **se extendió**. **The imperfect** describes the background: what the place was like, what happened repeatedly: **era**, **tenía**, **había**.

**En aquella época las carreteras eran de tierra.** (background) **Un inventor construyó una máquina de madera.** (event)

**The historic present** adds vividness: «en 1885 aparece la bicicleta moderna».

**The passive with ser** is very common in history: **fue fabricada**, **fueron inventados**. The participle agrees with the subject.
b4.e0.texto: A German inventor built a wooden machine.
b4.e1.texto: At that time the roads were made of earth.
b4.e2.texto: The fashion soon spread across all of Europe.
b5.f0.texto: In the workshop it smelled of oil, iron and freshly cut wood.
b5.f1.texto: Through the window came a golden light that lit the dust on the floor.
b5.f2.texto: On the table the chains gleamed like silver snakes.
b5.f3.texto: The inventor, a tall, thin man, filed a pedal with great patience.
b5.f4.texto: The neighbours peered in at the door and laughed at that strange machine.
b5.f5.texto: One summer Sunday the inventor took the bicycle out into the street.
b5.f6.texto: He climbed onto the saddle, pushed the pedal and set off slowly towards the square.
b5.f7.texto: The wheels turned with a soft squeak over the stones.
b5.f8.texto: The children ran after the machine amid laughter and shouts.
b5.f9.texto: That afternoon began a fashion that spread across the whole country.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: centuries are read with cardinal numbers.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It exists, but almost nobody says it: the cardinal is used.
b7.o0.refuerzo: The imperfect describes the background, not a specific event.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Yes: the preterite tells a dated event.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That is future; the event already happened.
b7.pregunta: Which tense tells a specific past event?
b8.frase: A mediados del siglo diecinueve aparecieron los pedales
b8.traduccion: In the middle of the nineteenth century pedals appeared
b9.o1.refuerzo: The future has its own forms: «aparecerá».
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes: the imperfect paints the background, what everything was like.
b9.pregunta: What is the imperfect for in a history text?
b11.frase: La bicicleta fue ____ en una pequeña fábrica.
b11.o1.refuerzo: It is masculine; «la bicicleta» is feminine.
b11.o2.refuerzo: It is a conjugated verb; after «fue» a participle is needed.
b12.o1: la goma llena de aire de la rueda
b12.o1.refuerzo: Yes: the tyre covers the wheel and holds air inside.
b12.o2: la cadena que mueve la rueda
b12.o2.refuerzo: That is the chain, not the tyre.
p.apareció.consejo: Third person of «aparecer», to appear, in the past.
p.pedales.consejo: Plural of «pedal», the part you press with your feet to move a bike.
p.ciclista.consejo: «Ciclista» is used for men and women alike.
p.empujaba.consejo: Imperfect of «empujar», to push: an action going on in the past.
p.pusieron.consejo: Third person plural in the past of «poner», to put.
p.añadieron.consejo: Third person plural in the past of «añadir», to add.
p.delantera.consejo: Feminine of «delantero»: «rueda delantera» is the front wheel.
p.fabricaba.consejo: Imperfect of «fabricar», to make in a factory.
p.bicicletas.consejo: Plural of «bicicleta»; «bici» is a short form.
p.fabricada.consejo: Feminine participle of «fabricar», agreeing with the noun.
p.neumáticos.consejo: The rubber part of a wheel, from «neumático».
p.hicieron.consejo: Third person plural in the past of «hacer»; the «c» sounds like «th».
p.viajes.consejo: Plural of «viaje», a trip from one place to another.
p.construyó.consejo: Third person of «construir» in the past; the «ó» takes the stress.
p.carreteras.consejo: Plural of «carretera», a road for cars.
p.moda.consejo: «Estar de moda» means to be trendy.
p.extendió.consejo: Past of «extenderse»; the e becomes ie in the present: «se extiende».
p.entraba.consejo: Imperfect of «entrar»: the light kept coming in, in the past.
p.iluminaba.consejo: Imperfect of «iluminar», to light up something, in the past.
p.cadenas.consejo: Plural of «cadena», a chain of linked metal rings.
p.serpientes.consejo: Plural of «serpiente»; the «ie» is one syllable.
p.limaba.consejo: Imperfect of «limar», to file or smooth metal.
p.asomaban.consejo: Imperfect of «asomarse» for «ellos», to look out or peer.
p.reían.consejo: The «í» breaks the diphthong: re-Í-an, two syllables.
p.sacó.consejo: Past of «sacar», to take out; the «ó» takes the stress.
p.subió.consejo: Past of «subir», third person: the «ó» takes the stress.
p.sillín.consejo: The seat of a bicycle; the «ll» sounds like «y».
p.empujó.consejo: Past of «empujar», to push; the «j» sounds like «h».
p.giraron.consejo: Third person plural of «girar» in the past; the «g» before «i» sounds like «h».
p.corrieron.consejo: Third person plural of «correr» in the past: the «rr» is strong.
p.diecinueve.consejo: Nineteen, written as one word; the «ci» sounds like «thi».
p.mediados.consejo: «A mediados de» means around the middle of a period.
p.aparecieron.consejo: Third person plural of «aparecer» in the past, to appear.
